seed: Express the mechanics as pairwise interactions between types with named guards, such as blocking, pushing, collecting or toggling, and derive single-type rules from them.

synth.notes:
Clicking a tile toggles its colour tag between color_14 and color_15.
Clicking an operator toggles its own marker (14 to 15 or back) and every orthogonally adjacent tile at a cell offset of 8.
Glyphs are inert. Clicks on glyphs or empty cells and all non-click actions do nothing.
The rule is stateless and finds the clicked object by its bounding box (highest layer wins).
Unconfirmed: whether operators also affect neighbouring operators or glyphs; no click produced that case.
